paper_title: No evidence for axions from Chandra observation of magnetic white dwarf
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1 as plotted on the y-axis, for the C_aee = C_agammagamma scenario (this-work dashed limit line)
notes: Chandra X-ray observation of magnetic white dwarf RE J0317-853. Primary model-independent result is on the product g_aee*g_agamma < 1.3e-25 GeV^-1 (95% CL) for m_a << 1e-5 eV. Emitted values are the translated limit g_agamma < 5.5e-13 GeV^-1, valid for m_a <~ 5e-6 eV, under the DFSZ-like assumption C_aee = C_agamma (as shown in the paper's Fig. 1). For the conservative W-phobic loop-induced C_aee = 1.6e-4*C_agamma the limit weakens to g_agamma <~ 4.4e-11 GeV^-1. Limit is flat at low mass and degrades above ~5e-6 eV (no tabulated high-mass values available). Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumption.
